description:
Candidate places for a name, best match first, each with coordinates, full name and kind (city, island, volcano...).

Call it only when a name is ambiguous (several Springfields) or one place is used in several calls: every place tool takes a name itself and uses its best match. GeoNames gazetteer in every language; no street addresses.

language.description: Language code for the name of the place found (resolved_from); the rest of the answer is English

query.description: A place name in any language or script, optionally followed by the region or country it lies in after a comma: Springfield, Missouri

name: find_place

display_name.description: The full name, with the region and country

kind.description: What the name is: city, town, village, state, country, island and so on

spelled.description: Found by a name spelled nearly like the one asked, not by that name

title: Find a place
